text: Evidence from a downstream host (eyes4s Studio S4.2), 11,520 marks at 2x: 200 NamedPicking hits over one batch took 1,618 ms (one giant target) versus 1.5 ms with one named grob per mark; the per-mark workaround costs 4.6x lowering and 10x JavaFX compile time. Per-index batch identity would remove the trade-off.
